title: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
title_zh: 通过分配残差学习预算改进多阶段任务的模仿策略
abstract_en: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.
abstract_zh: 残差强化学习（residual reinforcement learning）利用有限的环境交互来修正经模仿学习得到的基础策略。在多阶段任务中，失败最多的阶段不一定是修正后最能提高整体成功率的阶段。论文提出完成增益（completion gain）：在单个阶段用状态反馈控制器替换基础策略的部分动作分量后，整个任务完成概率的变化。该指标可分解为到达该阶段的概率与从该阶段起始状态出发的条件完成概率增量之积，并通过配对试验（paired episodes）估计。作者根据正增益估计选择残差策略要修正的动作分量，并在各阶段间分配训练回合。随机点质量对接实验中，失败主要发生在最终对接阶段，但完成增益最大的是前一通道阶段。按增益分配优于按失败次数比例分配；在接近过程更长的变体中，使用一半预算时，按增益分配也优于均匀分配。在仿真双臂机器人装配中，仅插入和释放阶段的完成增益估计为正，尽管释放阶段很少失败。在另一种装配配置中，仅在释放阶段训练的残差策略使从留出释放起始状态出发的任务完成率提高了 16.9%。
key_points_zh: 失败发生在哪里，与修正哪里最能提高整项任务的完成率，是两个不同的问题。
完成增益等于阶段到达概率乘以该阶段的条件完成率增量；用配对试验估计后，可据此选择修正的动作分量并分配训练回合。
随机点质量对接中，最终对接阶段失败最多，前一通道阶段却最值得修正；按增益分配优于按失败次数分配。
双臂装配中，释放阶段虽少有失败，完成增益估计仍为正；在另一配置中，释放阶段的残差策略使留出起始状态上的完成率提高了 16.9%。
